answer: Anchor every epoch's state root onto a public chain such as Solana or Base: once written the hash is as fixed as quartz. Rewriting history then leaves a comet-trail of conflicting roots that honest nodes echo back and reject, and a sybil spinning up thousands of identities must pay real external settlement fees to re-anchor each forged fork, so faking accounts costs mounting on-chain money per identity instead of free local compute.
